What if GTA 6 could run on every phone? People would play it everywhere: on the street, on the bus, in cafés.
But it comes out on November nineteenth, only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series.
And it's over two hundred gigabytes, while lots of phones only have a hundred and twenty-eight.
The PlayStation 5's graphics chip is several times stronger than the best phones.
If it did run on a phone, it would heat up fast and slow itself down to protect its parts.
A PlayStation draws about two hundred watts while gaming. At that power, a phone battery would be empty in about six minutes.
And if millions downloaded it at once, internet networks around the world would jam.
But there is a way: cloud gaming. The game runs on a distant computer, and your phone only receives the picture.
The twist? Your phone today is several times stronger than the PlayStation 3 that ran GTA 5 in twenty thirteen.
